title: PMO intake message, version 1
description: One raw Teams message or Outlook email, delivered as one JSON file into the PMO inbox folder. See PMO-INTAKE-CONTRACT.md. Null is treated like a missing key everywhere except where a field is required.

sourceId.description: Stable id of the message in its source system. Used for de-duplication: the same sourceId is only ever turned into one proposal. Outlook: the message id. Teams flow: Conversation ID + '/' + message id, or the bare message id, or a value derived from the deep link. May be blank (empty, spaces or null): the app then derives a stable sha256-based id from source, sender, subject, receivedAt and the start of the body.

receivedAt.description: ISO 8601 date-time the message was sent/received, with offset or Z.

sender.description: Teams gives a display name only, so neither field is required on its own.

subject.description: Email subject, or the Teams chat/channel name. May be empty.

parentId.description: Teams: the id of the message replied to; null or empty when not a reply.

origin.description: Manual paste only: where the pasted text came from (teams, outlook or manual). Informational; it does not change how the item is filtered.

tenantId.description: Microsoft Entra tenant of the Teams message. The Deloitte-only filter checks it against config.allowedTenantIds. If absent it is read from the Teams deep link in `link`.

chatId.description: Teams: the Conversation ID (19:...@thread.v2, 19:...@unq.gbl.spaces, ...@thread.tacv2). Checked against config.teamsChatAllowlist; wins over a chat id read from `link`.

chatType.description: Free text, informational. The flow sends group or oneOnOne.

attachments.description: References only. The app never opens or downloads an attachment.

link.description: Teams message deep link (https://teams.microsoft.com/l/message/...) or outlook:<EntryID>.
